purpose: Lays core down from a release with the release's own lay-down, runs the installed floor and secret helper against the owner's folder, lays core down again and compares the owner's folder byte for byte. The release is a parameter so the verifier can point it at a packed release.
title: Round 1 journey: core laid down twice beside the owner's folder

testCases.description: End to end: core laid down from the release and laid down again after the floor has run leaves the owner's folder, the floor's records included, byte for byte the same.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-1-journey.test.js::on a laid-down core the floor holds through a send, a delete, an install, a secret and a second lay-down

testCases.description: End to end: after core is laid down again, the installed health check names every overlay planted at an installed core path and exits 1, while the installed floor still blocks the send.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-1-journey.test.js::on a laid-down core the floor holds through a send, a delete, an install, a secret and a second lay-down
